title: Santa Dive 🎅💦 2026
seo_title: Santa Dive 2026 at Chesterfield Family Center
description: Santa Dive 2026 is a holiday swim where kids swim with Santa and take festive photos above and below the water, then go home with an ornament craft kit and a free pool pass. It is for ages 6 months to 12 years, and an adult must accompany weak or non-swimmers in the pool. It runs Saturday, December 12, 2026, 5-7 PM at Chesterfield Family Center and Park, 2511 W Republic Rd, Springfield, MO; cost is $20 per Family Center member, $30 non-member, and $15 per additional child, and space is limited, so register by Dec. 9 at ParkBoard.org/Events, in person, or by calling 417-891-1616.
